# Ahmed Mahmoud

> Ahmed Mahmoud is a founder and builder based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. He is a communications professional and tech wizard. He founded FirstShow, a sponsorship company for events, creators and venues across Canada, and makes websites, brands, photo, video and free web tools. He is open to work anywhere.

## About
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Founder of FirstShow: https://firstshow.ca
- Communications professional and tech wizard. 2022 to 2026 in-house communications and digital: video, photography, live streams, websites, a CMS across multiple sites and a Canto digital asset library. Content passed 1 million impressions.
- Owner of AMZD Media since 2020: menu photography and corporate event coverage.
- Studied in the Journalism Diploma program at SAIT, 2020 to 2022.
- Certifications: Google Ads Search; HubSpot Digital Marketing, Social Media Marketing I and II, Sales Management, Revenue Operations.
